parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the access control policy group to modify.

parameters.name: AclName
parameters.description: The name of the access control policy group.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs.
